title: Jennifer Lawrence Enters Beauty Business With Hair Care Brand Mes°
summary: The Oscar-winning actress has teamed up with biotech entrepreneur Jasmina Aganovic to launch Mes°, a science-driven hair care brand designed to simplify routines and enhance hair health.
